stages.title: Floorplan
stages.note: A 150 x 150 µm die with rows for the cells. Nothing is placed yet.

stages.title: Tap cells
stages.note: 245 tap cells tie the wells to power at fixed spacing, and 94 endcaps close the ends of the rows.

stages.title: Power grid
stages.note: met1 rails along the rows, met4 and met5 straps across them.

stages.title: Rough placement
stages.note: Cells spread to shorten their wires. They may overlap.

stages.title: Pins
stages.note: The 18 ports go on the die edge, near the cells they connect to.

stages.title: Global placement
stages.note: Placement again, now pulled toward the pins.

stages.title: Port buffers
stages.note: Buffers on every port and on heavily loaded nets.

stages.title: Detailed placement
stages.note: Every cell snaps into a row, with no overlaps.

stages.title: Clock tree
stages.note: One root and two leaf buffers carry clk to the 16 flip-flops.

stages.title: Timing repair
stages.note: The resizer upsizes gates and adds buffers on slow paths.

stages.title: Repair after global routing
stages.note: A second pass with the wire lengths of global routing.

stages.title: Detailed routing
stages.note: Every net gets real met1 to met5 wires.

stages.title: Fill and decap
stages.note: Decap and fill cells close every gap in the rows.
